title: ISO Lab: virtuals desk (DA vs RT by block)
description: Virtuals desk: DA minus RT per node, hour, day and month, by MISO trading block (dart_* marts, miso_hours).

list.name: node
list.label: Node
list.description: Pricing node (dart_monthly); the 8 trading hubs first.

query.rawSql:
SELECT node FROM dart_monthly
WHERE $__dateFilter(market_month)
GROUP BY node ORDER BY node NOT LIKE '%.HUB', node LIMIT 5000

list.definition:
SELECT node FROM dart_monthly
WHERE $__dateFilter(market_month)
GROUP BY node ORDER BY node NOT LIKE '%.HUB', node LIMIT 5000

options.content:
**Virtuals desk: day-ahead vs real time, per node and trading block** (marts `dart_hourly`, `dart_daily`, `dart_monthly`,
calendar `miso_hours`). **DA - RT** > 0 means day-ahead settled above real time: what 1 MW of **INC** (virtual supply) earned, before fees
and uplift; a **DEC** earns the opposite. Prices are exact cents. Blocks follow the traded MISO products: **on-peak** = HE08-23 Eastern
prevailing time, Mon-Fri, excluding NERC holidays (HE07-22 EST in summer); **2x16** = the same hours on weekends and holidays; **7x8** = nights.
Market days are MISO's fixed EST (UTC-5). Recent RT is preliminary until final lands ~5 days later.
[All quirks](https://github.com/AlverezYari/iso-market-data-lab/blob/main/docs/miso-quirks.md)

panels.title: Mean DA - RT by month and block at $node
panels.description: dart_monthly, monthly, $/MWh: mean DA minus RT per trading block. Positive = INC (virtual supply) earned; negative = DEC earned.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT formatDateTime(market_month, '%Y-%m') AS "month",
    anyIf(mean_da_minus_rt, block = 'on_peak') AS "on-peak", anyIf(mean_da_minus_rt, block = '2x16') AS "2x16", anyIf(mean_da_minus_rt, block = '7x8') AS "7x8"
FROM dart_monthly
WHERE node = ${node:singlequote} AND $__dateFilter(market_month)
GROUP BY market_month ORDER BY market_month

panels.title: On-peak DA - RT distribution by month at $node (median, p10, p90)
panels.description: dart_monthly, monthly, $/MWh, on-peak hours only. Exact quantiles: the median is the typical hour, p10/p90 the tails a scarcity hour lands in.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDateTime(market_month) AS time, median_da_minus_rt AS "median", p10_da_minus_rt AS "p10", p90_da_minus_rt AS "p90", mean_da_minus_rt AS "mean"
FROM dart_monthly
WHERE node = ${node:singlequote} AND block = 'on_peak' AND $__dateFilter(market_month)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Cumulative INC P&L per MW at $node by block ($)
panels.description: dart_daily, daily, $ per MW: running sum of DA - RT over every hour of the block since the start of the range = what holding 1 MW of INC in that block every day would have earned, before fees and uplift. A DEC is the mirror image.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDateTime(market_date) AS time, block, sum(sum_da_minus_rt) OVER (PARTITION BY block ORDER BY market_date) AS value
FROM dart_daily
WHERE node = ${node:singlequote} AND $__dateFilter(market_date)
ORDER BY time, block

panels.title: Hourly DA - RT at $node
panels.description: dart_hourly, hourly (aggregated to the panel interval), $/MWh: DA minus RT, split into energy, congestion and loss. Positive = day-ahead premium.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(interval_start_utc) AS time,
    avg(da_minus_rt) AS "DA - RT", avg(da_minus_rt_congestion) AS "congestion", avg(da_minus_rt_loss) AS "loss"
FROM dart_hourly
WHERE node = ${node:singlequote} AND $__timeFilter(interval_start_utc)
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Largest on-peak DA premiums over the range (top 20 nodes)
panels.description: dart_monthly, on-peak block, over the dashboard range: mean DA - RT ($/MWh, hour-weighted), INC hit rate and hours. Large positive = INC side; large negative = DEC side. Only nodes still trading in the latest month and with at least half the on-peak hours of the best-covered node: retired or renamed nodes (some stop mid-range) would otherwise rank on spreads they no longer have.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT node, round(sum(sum_da_minus_rt) / sum(hours), 2) AS "mean DA - RT", round(sum(inc_hit_rate * hours) / sum(hours), 3) AS "INC hit rate",
    sum(hours) AS "hours in range", sum(prelim_hours) AS "prelim RT hours"
FROM dart_monthly
WHERE block = 'on_peak' AND $__dateFilter(market_month)
GROUP BY node
HAVING sum(hours) >= 0.5 * (SELECT max(h) FROM (SELECT sum(hours) AS h FROM dart_monthly
                                   WHERE block = 'on_peak' AND $__dateFilter(market_month) GROUP BY node))
   AND max(market_month) = (SELECT max(market_month) FROM dart_monthly WHERE $__dateFilter(market_month))
ORDER BY "mean DA - RT" DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Largest on-peak RT premiums over the range (top 20 nodes)
panels.description: dart_monthly, on-peak block, over the dashboard range: the DEC side, most negative mean DA - RT ($/MWh, hour-weighted). Only nodes still trading in the latest month and with at least half the on-peak hours of the best-covered node: retired or renamed nodes (some stop mid-range) would otherwise rank on spreads they no longer have.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT node, round(sum(sum_da_minus_rt) / sum(hours), 2) AS "mean DA - RT", round(1 - sum(inc_hit_rate * hours) / sum(hours), 3) AS "DEC hit rate",
    sum(hours) AS "hours in range", sum(prelim_hours) AS "prelim RT hours"
FROM dart_monthly
WHERE block = 'on_peak' AND $__dateFilter(market_month)
GROUP BY node
HAVING sum(hours) >= 0.5 * (SELECT max(h) FROM (SELECT sum(hours) AS h FROM dart_monthly
                                   WHERE block = 'on_peak' AND $__dateFilter(market_month) GROUP BY node))
   AND max(market_month) = (SELECT max(market_month) FROM dart_monthly WHERE $__dateFilter(market_month))
ORDER BY "mean DA - RT" ASC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Trading-block calendar: hours per month
panels.description: miso_hours, monthly over the range: hours in each block (on_peak / 2x16 / 7x8) and how many fell in daylight saving. Check here that a month's on-peak count matches 16 x its non-holiday weekdays.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT formatDateTime(market_month, '%Y-%m') AS "month", countIf(block = 'on_peak') AS "on-peak", countIf(block = '2x16') AS "2x16", countIf(block = '7x8') AS "7x8",
    countIf(is_dst) AS "DST hours", uniqExactIf(ept_date, is_nerc_holiday) AS "NERC holidays"
FROM miso_hours
WHERE $__dateFilter(market_date)
GROUP BY market_month ORDER BY market_month DESC
